src/metrics/smoothing.rs.description: RollingAverage struct uses u16 values with configurable window_size. Factory methods: three_second() (window=3), thirty_second() (window=30). Used for power smoothing. Need ten_second() for cadence.

src/metrics/calculator.rs.description: Cadence rolling averages in process(): converts u8 cadence to u16 for RollingAverage.add(), then maps result back to u8 with .map(|v| v as u8). Pattern: self.cadence_3s.add(cadence as u16).map(|v| v as u8)

src/ui/screens/ride.rs.description: Full-screen mode cadence display in render_full_screen_mode() now uses cadence_3s_avg.or(self.metrics.cadence) pattern, consistent with main metrics display. Both use .or() for smoothed with raw fallback.
